slides.0.title: Course Introduction
slides.0.content: Centre-Loire Hidden Gems — This course covers Menetou-Salon, Quincy, Reuilly, Coteaux-du-Giennois, Châteaumeillant, and Saint-Pourçain, exploring the geography, soils, varieties, and stylistic characteristics of each AOC. These often overlooked appellations offer Sancerre-level quality at half the price.
slides.1.title: Centre-Loire Hidden Gems
slides.1.content:
This course systematically explores the terroir characteristics of Menetou-Salon, Quincy, Reuilly, Coteaux-du-Giennois, Châteaumeillant, and Saint-Pourçain, helping you build a solid knowledge framework for the Loire Valley.

Through systematic study, you will be able to identify the typical styles of these AOCs and accurately describe their characteristics during tasting.
slides.2.title: Quiz
slides.2.questions.0.question: Which of the following AOCs is covered in this course?
slides.2.questions.0.explanation: Menetou-Salon is an important AOC in the Loire Valley and a core subject of this course. Located ~30 km southwest of Sancerre, it primarily uses Kimmeridgian marl soils (same origin as Sancerre's Terres Blanches) to produce Sauvignon Blanc whites and Pinot Noir reds/rosés — offering excellent quality at around 60–70% of the Sancerre price.
